scenario: The airline misplaced my suitcase when I landed in Paris but found it later. Can I claim baggage delay?
B_notes: Length of the baggage delay not stated.

scenario: My suitcase came off the plane with scratches and a dent, but it still works fine. Can I claim for the damage?
B_notes: Scratches and dents that do not affect function count as wear and tear.

scenario: I have had asthma for years. I had a bad attack in Tokyo and needed hospital treatment. I did not buy the pre-existing conditions add-on. Can I claim?
B_notes: Known condition before the trip; optional cover not bought.

scenario: I accidentally knocked over an expensive vase in a shop in Kyoto and the owner took me to court. I was ordered to pay damages. Is that covered?
B_notes: Legal liability for accidental damage to another person's property.

scenario: I rented a bicycle in Amsterdam and accidentally hit a pedestrian, who is now suing me. Will my policy cover it?
B_notes: Liability from using bicycles is excluded.

scenario: The WHO declared a pandemic, so I cancelled my trip to Europe. Can I claim my cancellation costs?
B_notes: Declared epidemic or pandemic is a general exclusion.

scenario: I was summoned as a witness in court during my travel dates, so I postponed my trip to Japan by two months and paid rebooking fees. Can I claim them?
B_notes: Court witness is a listed event; rebooking within 180 days.

scenario: My father died while I was on holiday in London, so I flew home early and paid for a new economy ticket. Can I claim?
B_notes: Death of a family member; extra return cost.

scenario: My sister died while I was in New York, so I flew home early in business class. Can I claim the whole business-class fare?
B_notes: Return cost covered at economy; the upgrade is excluded.

scenario: I forgot to buy insurance, so I bought it at the airport after landing in Bangkok. Then my bag was stolen. Can I claim?
B_notes: Policy bought after departing Singapore does not start.

scenario: My flight home to Singapore was delayed 8 hours and I had to pay for an extra night for my dog at the kennel. Can I claim?
B_notes: Not stated whether the optional Pet care cover was bought.

scenario: The airline damaged my golf clubs on my trip to Thailand. Can I claim?
B_notes: Sports equipment is excluded from baggage cover; depends on whether the optional sports equipment cover was bought.

scenario: Three weeks before my trip, my sister had a life-threatening stroke confirmed by her doctor, so I postponed the trip by a month and paid rebooking fees. Can I claim them?
B_notes: Sister is a family member; life-threatening illness is a postponement event.

B_notes: Not stated whether the doctor said the insured could not return, or whether another adult family member was there.

scenario: My suitcase was stolen from my hotel room in Rome. I reported it to the police the same day. It had about S$300 of clothes. Can I claim?
B_notes: Theft of personal baggage overseas, reported within 24 hours.
